description.en:
Yellow Light: Basic Attack

Summon Squeakie to shoot three shots in a row, dealing Electro DMG.

Yellow Light: Sprint

Dodge to perform Sprint and enter Zoom Mode. Lumi is unable to Dodge when performing Sprint.

Yellow Light: Zoom

When in this state, automatically shoot Glitters at a locked-on target and deal Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

Yellow Light: Plunging Attack

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

Red Light: Basic Attack

Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Red Light: Heavy Attack

Consume STA to strike the ground with Squeakie, causing an impact dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

Red Light: Plunging Attack

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

Red Light: Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
description.id:
Yellow Light: Basic Attack

Memanggil Squeakie untuk menembak tiga kali berturut-turut, memberikan Electro DMG.

Yellow Light: Sprint

Dodge untuk melakukan Sprint dan memasuki Zoom Mode. Lumi tidak dapat melakukan Dodge saat Sprint.

Yellow Light: Zoom

Dalam kondisi ini, otomatis menembakkan Glitters ke target yang terkunci dan memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.

Yellow Light: Plunging Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Electro DMG.

Red Light: Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Electro DMG.

Red Light: Heavy Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk menghantam tanah dengan Squeakie, menimbulkan benturan yang memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.

Red Light: Plunging Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Electro DMG.

Red Light: Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack tepat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG.

description.en:
Pounce

When in Yellow Light Mode, use Resonance Skill to perform Pounce, which consumes STA to pounce on the target before switching to Red Light Mode.
Lumi will perform a Pounce without STA cost when switched onto the field.

Rebound

When in Red Light Mode, use Resonance Skill to perform Rebound, which consumes STA to leap backward and attack the target before switching to Yellow Light Mode.

Yellow Light Mode

Perform ranged attacks when in Yellow Light Mode.

Red Light Mode

Perform melee attacks when in Red Light Mode.
description.id:
Pounce

Saat dalam Yellow Light Mode, gunakan Resonance Skill untuk melakukan Pounce, yang mengonsumsi STA untuk menerkam target sebelum beralih ke Red Light Mode.
Lumi akan melakukan Pounce tanpa biaya STA saat berganti masuk ke lapangan.

Rebound

Saat dalam Red Light Mode, gunakan Resonance Skill untuk melakukan Rebound, yang mengonsumsi STA untuk melompat mundur dan menyerang target sebelum beralih ke Yellow Light Mode.

Yellow Light Mode

Melakukan serangan jarak jauh saat dalam Yellow Light Mode.

Red Light Mode

Melakukan serangan jarak dekat saat dalam Red Light Mode.

description.en:
Energized Pounce

When Yellow Light Spark is fully recovered, replace Resonance Skill with Resonance Skill Energized Pounce that deals Electro DMG and enter Red Spotlight Mode. The DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG.
When in Red Spotlight Mode, the DMG Multiplier of Red Light: Basic Attack and Red Light: Heavy Attack is increased, with an extra amount of Sparks recovered.
Red Spotlight Mode ends after performing altogether 4 Basic Attacks and/or Heavy Attacks.

Energized Rebound

When Red Light Spark is fully recovered, replace Resonance Skill with Resonance Skill Energized Rebound that deals Electro DMG and enter Yellow Spotlight Mode. The DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG.
When in Yellow Spotlight Mode, Glitter is replaced by Glare, with an increased DMG Multiplier and an extra amount of Sparks recovered.
Yellow Spotlight Mode ends after shooting 6 Glares.

Laser

Casting Outro Skill consumes all Sparks obtained in the current mode.
Laser can be cast when the amount of consumed Sparks is greater than or equal to 25, dealing Electro DMG. The DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG.
Every 25 Sparks consumed generates 1 extra Laser beam, up to 4 Laser beams.

Yellow Light Spark

Lumi can hold up to 100 Yellow Light Sparks.
Lumi obtains Yellow Light Spark under the following conditions:
When Yellow Light: Basic Attack hits the target;
When Glitter hits the target;
When Glare hits the target;
When Resonance Skill Energized Rebound hits the target;
When casting Intro Skill Special Delivery.

Red Light Spark

Lumi can hold up to 100 Red Light Sparks.
Lumi obtains Red Light Spark under the following conditions:
When Normal Attack Navigation Support hits the target in Red Light Mode or Red Spotlight Mode.
description.id:
Energized Pounce

Saat Yellow Light Spark pulih sepenuhnya, Resonance Skill diganti dengan Resonance Skill Energized Pounce yang memberikan Electro DMG dan memasuki Red Spotlight Mode. DMG yang diberikan dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.
Saat dalam Red Spotlight Mode, pengali DMG Red Light: Basic Attack dan Red Light: Heavy Attack meningkat, dengan jumlah Sparks tambahan yang dipulihkan.
Red Spotlight Mode berakhir setelah melakukan total 4 Basic Attack dan/atau Heavy Attack.

Energized Rebound

Saat Red Light Spark pulih sepenuhnya, Resonance Skill diganti dengan Resonance Skill Energized Rebound yang memberikan Electro DMG dan memasuki Yellow Spotlight Mode. DMG yang diberikan dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.
Saat dalam Yellow Spotlight Mode, Glitter diganti dengan Glare, dengan pengali DMG yang meningkat dan jumlah Sparks tambahan yang dipulihkan.
Yellow Spotlight Mode berakhir setelah menembakkan 6 Glare.

Laser

Melancarkan Outro Skill mengonsumsi seluruh Sparks yang diperoleh pada mode saat ini.
Laser dapat dilancarkan saat jumlah Sparks yang dikonsumsi lebih dari atau sama dengan 25, memberikan Electro DMG. DMG yang diberikan dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.
Setiap 25 Sparks yang dikonsumsi menghasilkan 1 sinar Laser tambahan, hingga maksimal 4 sinar Laser.

Yellow Light Spark

Lumi dapat menyimpan hingga 100 Yellow Light Spark.
Lumi memperoleh Yellow Light Spark dalam kondisi berikut:
Saat Yellow Light: Basic Attack mengenai target;
Saat Glitter mengenai target;
Saat Glare mengenai target;
Saat Resonance Skill Energized Rebound mengenai target;
Saat melancarkan Intro Skill Special Delivery.

Red Light Spark

Lumi dapat menyimpan hingga 100 Red Light Spark.
Lumi memperoleh Red Light Spark dalam kondisi berikut:
Saat Normal Attack Navigation Support mengenai target dalam Red Light Mode atau Red Spotlight Mode.
